summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.90. Confirmed account takeover of a privileged lab-admin account. All 8 sign-ins originate from a single non-university Cloudvault VPS IP (45.142.10.9, Frankfurt, DE) via the flagged vulnerable VPN appliance (vpn-edge-01), with empty device_id. MFA was approved once at 21:31, followed immediately by 7 more successes across portal/lms with zero MFA prompts, consistent with session/cookie reuse or appliance-based MFA bypass after initial compromise. The rapid, automated portal/lms alternation and foreign VPS geolocation are unexplained by legitimate use. No contradicting benign evidence (no mail events, no known travel/VPN context). Contain is warranted to reset credentials, revoke sessions, and isolate the appliance exposure.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
